parts:
Hi Imran,

Great to know that you want to use the package. 
I am not sure about this error, but please try to install again some packages (e.g. "htmltools"). 
Please, copy and paste the code below in your RStudio:

install.packages("htmltools")
install.packages("devtools")
install.packages("sp")
install.packages("raster")
install.packages("rgdal")
install.packages("maptools")
devtools::install_github("filipematias23/FIELDimageR")

Let me know if it works,
Filipe

parts:
I recently had this issue as well. I was able to fix it by navigating to my R library (C:\...\Documents\R\win-library\4.0 for me on Windows) and deleting the htmltools file, then try the install again.

htmltools was recently updated and the update failed for me. Letting it reinstall solved it.
